_about: Loot pickup + equip UI (lane LOOTUI v85), read by Scripts/Loot/LootCfg.cs (StreamingAssets first, then Assets/Data). Everything the player sees is here: keys, colours, layout, text, slot list, stat labels, rarity colours, marker look. Sizes are px at referenceHeight (1080) and scale with Screen.height like hud.json. Colours are [r,g,b(,a)] 0..1 (the palette is the HUD's: ink / dim / charcoal / crimson / gold / frame). enabled=false = no loot UI at all. Harness runs (-balanceauto, -autoplay, ...) never start it; -lootdemo drops demo.items in front of the player and lets Tab open the screen any time.

fonts._about: OS serif faces through Font.CreateDynamicFontFromOSFont, first installed name wins (same list as hud.json fonts); none installed = Unity default font.

keys._about: KeyCode names (old Input Manager). pickup: E / pad X (JoystickButton2). toggle (open AND close): Tab / pad Start (JoystickButton7). close: Esc / pad B. confirm: E / pad A = equip the selected item (again = take off). unequip: U / Delete / pad X. up / down / left / right + the stick axes move (left / right switch column). The pickup only works after the fight; Tab only opens outside a live fight (Tab is the lock-on key there). E is also the roll key and pad X special 2, which is harmless after the fight.

pillar._about: World marker: `planes` crossed vertical quads (soft sine edge, long fade to the top) + a ground glow disc, both additive on `shader` (Furnace/Particle, the FX shader already in the player; a missing shader = label only). Tint = rarity colour. intensity is per plane (3 planes overlap on the axis): tune it down if the core clips to white. height / width / groundRadius in metres. pulse = slow brightness breathing. fadeInS = grow-in; flash* = the flare when taken. groundRay* = how far above / below the drop point the floor is searched.

label._about: The item name above the pillar (serif, rarity colour) + rarity / slot line + the pickup prompt when near. height = metres above the pillar foot; fades out between fadeStartM and fadeEndM from the camera.

pickup._about: requireVictory: markers appear only after a VICTORY (spawnDelayS after it, after the finisher scene). radius = reach to press the key; promptRadius = distance the prompt shows. spread = metres between markers that drop at one point. fallbackDrops: when no drop source is registered (LootBridge.HasDropSource false, i.e. no GearDrop) these item ids drop at the fallen foe fallbackAfterS after the markers would have appeared. autoPickup = walking over it takes it (no key).

screen._layoutNote: HCKIT6 v100: insetPx..messageS below are the paddings / line factors LootScreen.cs held as literals (line heights = x font size). Every value equals the old literal.
screen._about: Equip screen layout (px at 1080). Three columns: slots (slotColW), carried items (candColW), details (the rest). openInFight false = Tab opens it only when no fight is live (victory, defeat, or no duel in the scene).

text.title: Equipment
text.subtitle: What you wear and what you carry

save._about: Written to Application.persistentDataPath/<file> after every pickup / equip / take off.

catalog._about: gear.json (lane GEAR schema) is read for item names / slots / stats. gearStatKeys name its stats{armor, poise, weight} in the stats list below (same order).

demo._about: -lootdemo: these ids drop in front of the player spawnAfterS after the scene starts.
